> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json`, `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **171** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a7c97297e661c985dc6a2fb9cfb6106419fd8609` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `ea431a17dc2aa5f8679e9eb45a155955efaf5c95` — the merge of head `6ab0ff157cea39573c2be7301b6a130cc7add833` into base `a7c97297e661c985dc6a2fb9cfb6106419fd8609`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin ea431a17dc2aa5f8679e9eb45a155955efaf5c95 && git checkout ea431a17dc2aa5f8679e9eb45a155955efaf5c95
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin a7c97297e661c985dc6a2fb9cfb6106419fd8609 6ab0ff157cea39573c2be7301b6a130cc7add833 && git checkout -B drift-repro a7c97297e661c985dc6a2fb9cfb6106419fd8609 && git merge --no-ff 6ab0ff157cea39573c2be7301b6a130cc7add833

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a7c97297e661c985dc6a2fb9cfb6106419fd8609
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs a7c97297e661c985dc6a2fb9cfb6106419fd8609` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `631dda6fb0c220c2b6ffc85a4d948a9a55e63d36`
Local-runs: none
Scope: hits — `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/data/stage-field-kinds.ts`, `packages/spec/src/data/object-icon.ts`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.blueprint-stage-field-option-kind-required.ts`; declaration face — the `Clause-②:` / `Metadata-protocol:` lines of `.changeset/32762-blueprint-object-view-parity.md` and the PR body; implementing or enforcing files in the diff — `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json`, `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`

Read, not reviewed: cards #32762 / #32763 / #32764 with every comment, the seat order, the PR body (its test counts, gate list and ablation table are the dev's readings; nothing was run here and CI was not read), the prose of the changeset and of `content/docs/references/ai/solution-blueprint.mdx` (prose face, the seat's ACCEPT), and code outside the diff (`ui/view.zod.ts`, `shared/identifiers.zod.ts`, `packages/lint/src/lint-view-refs.ts`, `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`, `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`, `packages/spec/scripts/dropped-refinements.test.ts`). The cloud repo (the `apply_blueprint` applier and stager) is not in this checkout, so every statement about it below is unverified.

### ① Derived judgments

- **#32764 reuses the rule, no copy.** `BlueprintObjectSchema` ends in `.superRefine(refuseBlueprintStageFieldWithoutKinds)` (`solution-blueprint.zod.ts:411`); that adapter only turns the field array into a name-keyed map and calls the shared `refuseStageFieldWithoutKinds` (`:368-384`, call at `:380`), imported from `data/stage-field-kinds.ts` (`:10`). No rule text is duplicated.
- **The move is behaviour-preserving for `ObjectSchema`.** The body removed from `object.zod.ts` and the body in `stage-field-kinds.ts:69-134` differ in two places only, both behind the defaulted fifth parameter: the closing sentence of `prescription` (`:91`) and the path segment (`:126`). The default `OBJECT_STAGE_FIELD_SPELLING` (`:28-31`) returns the field name and the original sentence, and the `ObjectSchema` call site passes four arguments (`object.zod.ts:4392`), so guards, issue codes, paths and messages are the same bytes as before. `icon: OBJECT_ICON_SCHEMA` (`object.zod.ts:3268`) is the same `z.string().optional()` with the same describe (`object-icon.ts:16`).
- **Nothing new on the public surface.** Neither new module is re-exported: `data/index.ts` names neither, the only importers are `object.zod.ts:31,33` and `solution-blueprint.zod.ts:9-10`, the `exports` map has no wildcard subpath, and `packages/spec/api-surface/**` and `export-origins/**` are untouched by the diff. `StageFieldSpelling` and `OBJECT_ICON_SCHEMA` are module exports, not package exports.
- **#32763 is the same leaf.** Lenient: `OBJECT_ICON_SCHEMA.describe(...)` (`:399`); strict mirror: `OBJECT_ICON_SCHEMA.unwrap().nullable()` (`:770`). No looser re-declaration. `authorable-surface/ai.json` gains exactly `ai/BlueprintObject:icon`.
- **#32762 follows the seat call.** `BLUEPRINT_VIEW_NAME` (`:463`) admits the bare key or one qualifier segment; `refuseForeignViewQualifier` (`:474-492`) refuses a qualifier that is not the view's `object`, at `['name']`, and stays silent when the pattern already failed. The `.describe` states the rule, including the refusal (`VIEW_NAME_RULE`, `:466`, used at `:511`). The strict mirror keeps the bare key (`:819`), narrower than the lenient side and never wider.
- **The other view doors agree, as the dev reported.** `ViewItemNameSchema` requires the dotted form (`ui/view.zod.ts:5834-5840`); the metadata publish door takes both (`METADATA_ITEM_NAME_PATTERN`, `shared/identifiers.zod.ts:166-168`); lint `resolvesViewId` treats `OBJECT.key` and `key` as one view only when the prefix is the view's object (`packages/lint/src/lint-view-refs.ts:113-119`). No fork. The cloud stager row is the card's measurement, not checked here.
- **ADR-0087 entry matches its neighbour.** Same `SemanticMigration` shape and file naming as `18.stage-field-option-kind-required.ts` (id, surface, replacement, reason, acceptanceCriteria; no `conversionIds`, correct for an entry with no conversion). The changeset marker names the new id (`.changeset/...:9`).
- **First-party exposure of the narrowing: 0, confirmed by grep.** No blueprint literal or schema reader outside `packages/spec` and one lint test in this tree; no hit for `SolutionBlueprint`, `defineSolutionBlueprint`, `apply_blueprint` or `BlueprintObject` in hotcrm (HEAD 8277e61).

### ② Semver level

- `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` with `'@objectstack/spec': minor` is correct: added (#32762, #32763) plus narrowed (#32764) is "several ⇒ `narrowed`", and a kind other than `none` takes at least `minor` (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3, `:1022-1027`). Both lines are line-leading in the changeset (`:7-8`) and in the PR body, and both match the key patterns in `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`.
- **`Clause-②: yes` carries no arm, and the diff owes `(narrowing)`.** `clause2-line.mjs:111-116` spells this exact case: "`yes (narrowing)` — a diff that widens one surface and narrows another. Both facts are true and both are read." The PR body's reason for leaving it off ("a narrowing whose refused set was already refused downstream") does not hold for two published accept sets: (a) `SolutionBlueprintStrictSchema.objects[]` gains a required `icon` key (`:770`), so strict output that parsed before is refused now, and the PR body itself says cloud's fixtures must add `icon: null`; (b) `SolutionBlueprintSchema` and the exported `defineSolutionBlueprint` now refuse input they accepted, whatever a later door did. AGENTS.md: "`(narrowing)` is BREAKING". The arm also decides the full dogfood battery (`os-dev.md:273`, `review-checklist.md:48`), which the report marks n/a on the strength of the missing arm.
- The migration statement a breaking changeset owes is present (the changeset's closing `Migration:` paragraph), and the ADR-0087 disposition is present.
- `Skills-docs: none — REASON` is a listed spelling and the reason holds: the only `skills/**` mention of the blueprint schema is the pointer at `skills/objectstack-ai/references/_index.md:16`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Contract-face consumers in this repo: none breaks.** The one reader is `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.formula-one-hop.test.ts:23,127-129`, which reads `.shape` of `BlueprintObjectSchema`; a zod 4 `.superRefine` keeps the object class, and the same file already reads `.shape` of the refined `BlueprintFieldSchema`. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/mapMessages.ts` names the schemas in comments only. There is no `apply_blueprint` implementation in this tree.
- **Cloud, unverified (carrier: cloud).** (1) Hand-built strict output and its TypeScript type need `icon`. (2) Any cloud code that calls `.pick`, `.omit` or `.extend` on `BlueprintObjectSchema` or `BlueprintViewSchema` should be checked: both now carry a refinement, which zod 4 object derivation can refuse. (3) Passing `icon` to the staged object and nav entry is still cloud work; until then the key parses and is dropped.
- **"Every blueprint this refuses was already refused at the object write"** rests on the applier copying fields 1:1. The spec test pins that for a 1:1 copy against `ObjectSchema`; the applier itself is cloud's.
- **Duplicate field names.** The adapter judges the first entry of a repeated name (`:372-379`) on the stated ground that the applier keys fields by name. If the applier keeps the last entry, a blueprint with a clean first `status` and a kind-less second one still parses and half-stages. Not pinned by a test, not verifiable here.
- PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` via the relay; no off-relay author to name.

### ④ Design judgment

- **`solution-blueprint.zod.ts`: sound.** Running the object's own function over a derived map is the right way to make the two doors agree, and the parity walk in the test compares both doors case by case. Keeping the strict mirror bare-only is the right direction for a cross-key rule a per-leaf mirror cannot state, and it is named in `DELIBERATE_NARROWER_MIRROR` (`solution-blueprint.test.ts:1213`) so the drift is declared, not silent.
- **`object.zod.ts`, `stage-field-kinds.ts`, `object-icon.ts`: sound.** Two small non-barrel modules keep `ObjectSchema` out of the `/ai` entry's graph and add no export; the defaulted parameter is the smallest change that lets one function serve both shapes.
- **Migration entry: acceptable.** The gate refuses `not-required` on a `narrowed` changeset, and a D3 entry with no conversion is the neighbour's shape. Cost, accepted: the entry is listed as a TODO for every stack crossing major 18 although no stack can contain a blueprint, and no `relevantWhen` can prove it absent (a blueprint is not a stack key).
- **Open question (dropped-refinements growth): A, admit.** The ledger records each position where the published JSON Schema is wider than the runtime because a `.refine` has no JSON form; it is shrink-only on a repair, and its own description says a refinement outside the closed projectable list "stays here" and that adding an arm is a public-contract decision. Both new rules are cross-key and data-dependent (an option's `kind` required only when a sibling `stageField` names that field; a name prefix equal to a sibling `object`), so JSON Schema cannot state either exactly and no arm in `refinement-projection.ts` fits. The four sites are the two roots plus their two embeddings in `ai/SolutionBlueprint`, the same pattern as the existing `ai/BlueprintField` `""` and `objects.element.fields.element` rows, and the header total moves by exactly four (1050 → 1054). Option B would hold a p2 fix behind a new projection arm for no gain in what the file can say; the pattern half of the view name does project. The refinements survive at runtime; only the file stays wider, and it is annotated.
- Nits, no effect on correctness: the qualified form uses the blueprint's `SNAKE_CASE` segment (leading `_` allowed, `:463`) while the stored-view grammar starts with a letter (`shared/identifiers.zod.ts`), a gap the bare key already had; `open_list` and `ticket.open_list` on one object now both parse and name one view, with no uniqueness rule in the blueprint (the bare key could already be repeated); the `BlueprintNavItemSchema` docblock still says a blueprint's `views[].name` carries the bare key (`:587-589`).

Reviewed-by: domain:spec#3 seat (CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER subagent)

Verdict: FAIL

Must-fix:
1. Declare `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` at the start of a line in the changeset and the PR body, amend the claim line, and run the full dogfood battery once on the final head as the arm requires. No code change is asked; the schema work passes ① and ④ as it stands.

Should-fix:
1. Duplicate field names: either judge every entry that carries the stage field's name, or confirm in cloud that the applier keeps the first entry, and pin the choice with a test.
2. File the cloud carrier card for the three items in ③ (strict `icon`, `.pick`/`.omit`/`.extend` on the two refined schemas, passing `icon` through).

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ead9e107e2797314f2e80d751b338e4dda7cc0d6`
Local-runs: none
Scope: delta `631dda6f..ead9e107` (one commit, 3 files). Hits — `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts`; declaration face — the `Clause-②:` / `Metadata-protocol:` lines of `.changeset/32762-blueprint-object-view-parity.md`, the PR body and claim 6838331012; enforcing file in the diff — `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts`

Delta round on record 6838283650 (FAIL at `631dda6f`: must-fix 1, the `(narrowing)` arm and the dogfood battery; should-fix 1, same-named stage-field entries; should-fix 2, the cloud carrier, which is the seat's and is not judged here). Everything that record passed in ① and ④ outside the three delta files is byte-identical at this head (`git diff 631dda6f ead9e107` touches nothing under `packages/spec/src/data`, `api-surface`, `authorable-surface`, the ledger, the migration entry or `content/`) and is not re-reviewed. Read, not reviewed: dev report 6839336068 and the PR body's test, gate, ablation and dogfood figures (the dev's readings; nothing was run here and CI was not read); `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` was read, not executed. The cloud applier is not in this checkout.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Should-fix 1 is done: every carrier is judged at its own index.** The adapter returns unless `stageField` is a string and `fields` an array, then calls the shared function once per entry whose `name === stageField`, with a one-entry map and `fieldKey: () => index` (`solution-blueprint.zod.ts:369-384`, call at `:379`). The shared function reads only `fieldMap[stageField]` (`data/stage-field-kinds.ts:79-84`), so a one-entry map is its whole input; `Object.fromEntries` keeps a `__proto__` name an own key, which the `hasOwnProperty` guard at `:79` needs.
- **No behaviour lost against the prior adapter.** The new early return on a non-string `stageField` repeats the shared function's own first guard (`stage-field-kinds.ts:76`); a `stageField` naming no entry stays silent, as before (`:79`); a single carrier produces the same issues at the same paths.
- **Issue paths are correct.** Option issues land at `['fields', <that entry's index>, 'options', k, 'kind']` (`stage-field-kinds.ts:126`), pointer issues at `['stageField']` (`:97`, `:110`).
- **`ObjectSchema` is untouched.** `stage-field-kinds.ts` and `object.zod.ts` are not in the delta; the default spelling and the four-argument call site stand as record 6838283650 read them.
- **The test pins both orders, exactly.** `solution-blueprint.test.ts:503-520`: clean `status` at index 1 and a kind-less one at index 2 gives exactly one issue at `['objects', 0, 'fields', 2, 'options', 0, 'kind']`; reversed, exactly one at index 1. `toEqual` on the full issue list also pins that the clean entry raises nothing.

### ② Semver level

- **Must-fix 1, the line: done on all three carriers.** Changeset `:7` is `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, bare and line-leading, with `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` at `:8` and `minor` at `:2`. The PR body carries the same bare line as its first `Clause-②` line; claim 6838331012 carries it too. Each matches `CLAUSE2_KEY_LINE` (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs:144`) with `yes` in `CLAUSE2_VALUES` (`:83`) and `narrowing` in `CLAUSE2_ARMS` (`:121`), a listed combination (`:113-114`). The PR body's later bullet that quotes the line in backticks sits after the declaration, and the reader returns on the first declaration (`:443-474`).
- **The BREAKING sentence names both narrowed accept sets correctly** (changeset `:18`): `SolutionBlueprintSchema` / `defineSolutionBlueprint` refuse what they parsed (`.superRefine` at `solution-blueprint.zod.ts:411`), and `SolutionBlueprintStrictSchema.objects[]` requires `icon`. The view-name change is a widening and is rightly not listed.
- **Must-fix 1, the battery: recorded on the final head.** The PR body's patch-round section and report 6839336068 give the full `@objectstack/dogfood` run on `ead9e107` (456 files passed, 3 skipped; 3831 tests passed, 42 skipped; exit 0), and the PR's head is `ead9e107`. A dev reading, not re-run here.
- **One sentence is now wider than the code.** Changeset `:14` says every refused blueprint "was already refused by the object write the applier makes from it", and `:20` says "Migration: none for a blueprint that applied before". With every carrier judged and no duplicate-name refusal anywhere in the blueprint schema, a blueprint with one clean and one kind-less same-named entry is refused in both orders, while an applier that keeps one entry writes a clean object in one of them. Unless the applier refuses duplicate field names (cloud, unverified), that blueprint applied before and is refused now. The arm and the level already cover it; only the two sentences overstate.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **No other contract face moves.** The rest of the `.zod.ts` delta is comment text (the adapter docblock and the `BlueprintNavItemSchema` docblock at `:587-592`, which closes a nit of the prior record). No `.describe` string, schema shape, export or generated file changes.
- **Cloud, unverified (carrier: cloud).** Which same-named entry the applier keeps is now moot for the half-staging defect: both are judged. The three cloud items of record 6838283650 ③ stand, listed in the report's `out_of_scope_findings` as "noted, not filed"; filing is the seat's.

### ④ Design judgment

- **`solution-blueprint.zod.ts`: sound.** Judging every carrier removes the bet on the applier's choice at the cost of refusing a malformed blueprint slightly early, which is the safe side for a parse that exists to stop half-staged builds. The adapter is shorter than the one it replaces and still holds no rule text.
- Nit, no effect on correctness: two same-named multi-value carriers raise two issues at the same `['stageField']` path.

Implemented-by: card thread session_016WV4cwwGpFXKeedERhEqbm
Reviewed-by: domain:spec#3 seat (CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER subagent)

Verdict: PASS

Should-fix:
1. Changeset `:14` and `:20` (and the matching PR-body sentence): qualify "already refused by the object write" and "Migration: none" for a blueprint that declares the stage field's name twice, and add the remedy (give every same-named entry its kinds, or remove the duplicate). Prose only.
2. Carried from record 6838283650: file the cloud carrier card (the seat's).

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · PR #32890 · head `6ab0ff157cea39573c2be7301b6a130cc7add833` · 2026-11-13T01:17Z
